comment: Twelve exchanges between a person and Cello. expected: each inner list is alternatives, and a stored memory must mention one of them. forbidden: no stored memory may contain any of these ('*' means no memory at all). Forbidden facts are things only Cello said.

cases.user: I'm in Seattle and only want remote roles. I'll need visa sponsorship from 2027.
cases.assistant: Sounds good. Acme is hiring a remote Staff Engineer at $210k, and Globex has a hybrid role in Austin.

cases.user: Can you find me roles in climate tech?
cases.assistant: Sure. ClimateCo is hiring in Denver and GreenGrid has openings in Boston.

cases.user: I've got 8 years in Go and I'm done with management, IC track only.
cases.assistant: Noted. Great IC roles are at Stripe and Cloudflare right now.
Anything else I can look up?

cases.user: The Datadog one is too junior, skip it.
cases.assistant: Datadog's Associate role pays $120k and is remote.

cases.user: My notice period is 4 weeks and I can't relocate.
cases.assistant: Many Bay Area roles require relocation within 60 days.

cases.user: Tell me about the Brightpay role.
cases.assistant: Brightpay is hiring a Senior Backend Engineer, remote US, $180k to $220k, Go and Kafka required.

cases.user: I want salary of at least 190k, and nothing in crypto.
cases.assistant: Understood. I'll filter for 190k+ and exclude Coinbase.

cases.user: I'm a product designer moving from agency work to in-house at a B2B company.
cases.assistant: Great, Figma and Notion both hire in-house B2B designers.
To summarize: you prefer remote, senior roles in fintech.

cases.user: I don't want to work with companies under 50 people.
cases.assistant: Got it, I'll skip startups. Some I found: Linear (30 people) and Ramp (800 people).

cases.user: I'm looking for part-time roles, 20 hours a week.
cases.assistant: Understood about part-time. Most listings I found are full-time, though.
